description: This file defines the 'SimpleTextAggregator' class, which provides basic sentence boundary detection and text aggregation for text-to-speech (TTS) processing. It accumulates input text and yields complete sentences based on punctuation and lookahead logic, coordinating with external string utilities and base classes.

classes.name: SimpleTextAggregator
classes.description: A straightforward text aggregator that accumulates text until it detects sentence boundaries based on punctuation and lookahead logic.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the aggregator with an empty text buffer and lookahead flag.

methods.name: Aggregation text(self)
methods.description: Returns the currently accumulated text as an Aggregation object with sentence type.

methods.name: AsyncIterator[Aggregation] aggregate(self, text: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously processes input text, accumulating characters, and yields completed sentences once detected.

methods.name: Optional[Aggregation] _check_sentence_with_lookahead(self, char: str)
methods.description: Implements lookahead logic to confirm sentence boundary detection, awaiting non-whitespace after punctuation.

methods.name: Optional[Aggregation] flush(self)
methods.description: Returns any remaining text in the buffer as a final sentence, resetting the aggregator.

methods.name: handle_interruption(self)
methods.description: Handles processing interruptions by clearing the internal text buffer.

methods.name: reset(self)
methods.description: Resets the internal state and clears accumulated text.

ctags.name: aggregate
ctags.pattern: /^    async def aggregate(self, text: str) -> AsyncIterator[Aggregation]:$/
